secrets.name: The Hollow Under the Caps
secrets.text: You crawl under the gills and stand up inside the ring. Somebody has been sleeping here, and the mushrooms have been reading over their shoulder.

meta.label: The Mushroom Stacks
meta.blurb: The shelves are damp and something has taken root in them. The mushrooms give off just enough light to read by, and they are growing toward the books.
